title: Soviet target-mice psi experiment in the Urals

tellings.quote: 12 and bottom 12 it was a perfect match all the bottom ones were controls all the top ones were Target mice

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest who speaks about psychic research, says he received a box of material from a Soviet psychic research unit, obtained after the Soviet Union opened up. He says it described an experiment in Russia's Ural Mountains where people tried to affect mice with their minds, and that when the results were sorted, the top 12 were all the target mice and the bottom 12 all the untouched control mice, a perfect match. If true, it would suggest the Soviets found evidence that the mind can act on living things at a distance.
